title: Minimal translation hypersurfaces in hyperbolic space
summary: In the upper half-space model of the hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}^{n+1}$, a translation hypersurface of type I is a graph $x_{n+1}=f_1(x_1)+\cdots+f_n(x_n)$ and a translation hypersurface of type II is a graph $x_n=f_1(x_1)+\cdots+f_{n-1}(x_{n-1})+g(x_{n+1})$. We classify the minimal translation hypersurfaces of both types for every $n\geq 2$.
